english.title: Obstruct person authorised to kill rabbits / hares / vermin
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), obstructed **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..) a person authorised by the appropriate forestry authority, in the exercise of

(A)_[his]_
(B)_[her]_

powers or duties under section 7(2) of the Forestry Act 1967 to enter on to land, namely **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..), to kill and take rabbits, hares or vermin
english.legislation: Contrary to section 7(4) of the Forestry Act 1967.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Section 7(2) of the Forestry Act 1967 provides that the appropriate forestry authority may, where they are so satisfied, authorise in writing any competent person to enter on the land and kill and take the rabbits, hares or vermin thereon; but before doing so shall first give to the occupier and owner of the land such opportunity as the appropriate forestry authority think reasonable of destroying the rabbits, hares or vermin, or of taking steps for the prevention of the damage.
